# Coden

Coden is an AI app builder for creating, previewing, iterating and publishing production-ready web apps.

## Important pages
- Home: https://coden.fun/
- Pricing: https://coden.fun/pricing.html
- Features: https://coden.fun/features.html
- Documentation: https://coden.fun/documentation.html
- Security: https://coden.fun/security.html

## Product facts
- Coden supports prompt-to-app generation, project preview, database visibility, publishing workflows and model selection.
- Coden is designed for founders, agencies, product teams and non-technical builders.
- Private app routes such as auth, dashboard and builder are not intended for indexing.
